app_description: Describe a social problem and Zaczyn finds proven innovations from Małopolska, or turns it into an open challenge for innovators.
footer_demo_data: Demo version: all reports and innovations are fictional and contain no real personal data.
a11y_easy_failed: We could not prepare an easy-to-read version. Please try again later.
auth_login_demo_note: This is a demo. Pick a role to see the platform as a resident, an NGO, a municipality, an expert or the ROPS team. Production will use login.gov.pl.
home_title: Your problem may already have a solution
home_lead: Describe in your own words what your area is struggling with. Zaczyn searches the ROPS Social Innovation Library and shows proven solutions. If none fits, your report becomes an open challenge for innovators across Małopolska.
home_step1_text: Write or say what is happening. No expert vocabulary needed.
home_step2_text: We show proven innovations and explain why they could help.
home_step3_title: No solution? It becomes a challenge
home_step3_text: Your report joins similar ones from other municipalities in an open challenge.
home_step4_text: Innovators propose ideas, we test them, and the best join the Library.
home_map_more: See the challenge map and data
home_prompt_title: What is happening in your area?
home_prompt_lead: Describe the problem in your own words. We will show proven solutions from the Social Innovation Library.
home_prompt_placeholder: E.g. older people in our village live alone and have no one to talk to…
home_prompt_hint: At least {min} characters. Ctrl+Enter sends. Do not include names or addresses.
home_example_1_text: In our village older people live alone, their children have moved abroad. They have no one to talk to, and the bus to town runs twice a day.
home_example_2_text: Teenagers in our municipality have nowhere to go after school. There is no youth club or activities, they hang around the bus stop and on their phones.
home_example_3_text: Parents of adult children with disabilities care for them around the clock. They are exhausted and do not get even a few hours of rest a week.
home_example_4_text: Residents of small villages without a car cannot get to a doctor in the county town. Older people are affected the most.
home_preview_note: We will check the fit properly after you send.
report_lead: Write what is happening, who it affects and where. You can also dictate.
report_text_help: At least {min} characters. Please do not include names, addresses or phone numbers.
report_placeholder: E.g. In our village older people live alone and have nobody to talk to. The bus runs twice a day…
report_too_short: The description is too short. Please write at least {min} characters.
report_privacy: We remove personal data automatically before searching. Others only see the anonymised description.
report_understood_empty: Start typing and we will show how we understand the report.
report_understood_fix: If something is wrong, add more detail to the description.
report_not_need_title: Is this a description of a problem?
report_not_need_text: Write what is happening and who it affects so we can find a solution.
report_pii_title: It looks like you included personal data
report_pii_text: We will remove it automatically, but it is better not to type it.
report_urgent_text: Call the emergency number 112. Mental health crisis support: 116 123 (adults) or 116 111 (children and young people). We have marked your report as urgent.
progress_noscript: Refresh the page in a few seconds to see the results.
results_matches_help: These innovations have been proven in Małopolska. You can bring them to your municipality.
results_uncertain_help: These solutions concern a similar area, but we are not confident they solve your problem.
results_challenge_text: So your report has joined the open challenges. Innovators across Małopolska can propose a solution.
results_challenge_idea: I have an idea for a solution
results_moderation_title: Your report is waiting for review
results_moderation_text: The description may contain personal data, so the ROPS team will check it before it is published. We will let you know.
match_accepted_toast: Thank you! This helps us improve matching.
similar_text: A similar problem was reported in {count} other municipalities.
similar_partner: An opportunity for a shared solution and a partnership of municipalities.
knowledge_lead: Social challenges of Małopolska, proven innovations and materials that help put them into practice.
knowledge_map_source: County boundaries: National Register of Boundaries (GUGiK). Data: reports in Zaczyn (demonstration).
map_legend: The darker the colour, the more reports (0 to {max}). Every county shows its number.
map_link_label: {powiat}: {count} reports. See challenges in this county.
map_open_hint: Click a county to see its challenges.
library_lead: Proven solutions from Małopolska: from simple everyday objects to new services and apps.
innovation_adapt_text: The Innovation Middleman prepares an implementation plan for your municipality or organisation.
translation_pending: Translation in progress. You are seeing the Polish version for now.
materials_lead: ROPS Kraków materials on social innovation and the problems it solves.
materials_canvas_text: A board that takes you from problem to solution: beneficiaries, value, partners, resources, risks and measures.
materials_report_text: The region's key social challenges, based on reports and the Social Challenges Map.
materials_guide_title: How to test an innovation at small scale
materials_guide_text: Step by step: from a pilot with a few people to a decision to scale up.
materials_etr_text: How to prepare information that older people, people with intellectual disabilities and foreigners can understand.
challenges_lead: Needs reported by residents that have no proven solution yet. Have an idea? Submit it.
challenges_empty: There are no open challenges right now.
challenges_empty_filtered: No open challenge matches the selected filters.
challenge_no_ideas: No ideas yet. Be the first!
idea_new_lead: Describe your social innovation idea in four short steps. It is a summary card: it does not need to be perfect.
idea_field_essence: What is the idea and which problem does it solve?
idea_field_essence_help: 2–3 sentences. What is the core of the idea?
idea_field_how: How does it work in practice?
idea_field_how_help: Who does what, and how often? How is it different from existing services?
idea_canvas_hint: Want to develop the idea further? Use the Social Innovation Canvas:
idea_checklist_help: We check as you write whether the key elements are there.
idea_created_title: Thank you! Your idea has been submitted.
idea_created_text: The ROPS team and an expert will review it. You will see the reply here and in your notifications.
assistant_lead: Talk with the assistant to develop your idea. Agreed points are saved to the Canvas.
assistant_empty: Ask a question or pick a suggestion.
assistant_starter_2: How can I test this at small scale?
assistant_error: Something went wrong. Please try again.
assistant_canvas_help: The assistant fills in fields once you agree on them.
calls_lead: While a call is open you can apply for funding for your idea. The generator fills in the application from your idea card.
calls_none_open: No call is open right now. We will let you know about the next one.
apply_choose_idea: Which idea is this application for?
apply_prefill_note: The application is filled in in Polish from your idea card and Canvas. Check and correct every field before sending.
apply_filled: Application filled in. Please review it.
apply_fill_error: We could not fill in the application. Please try again.
apply_no_ideas: Submit an idea first to apply.
tests_lead: Sign up to test new solutions, rate them and say what to improve. Your feedback goes straight to the authors.
tests_signed: You are signed up for this test.
tests_feedback_text: What works and what should be improved? (optional)
rating_legend: How do you rate the solution?
notif_need_matched: We found solutions for your report
notif_need_challenge: Your report joined the open challenges
notif_need_moderation: A new report is waiting for moderation
adapt_lead: Describe your institution and we will prepare a plan to deliver “{title}” as a service.
adapt_error: We could not prepare the plan. Please try again.
adapt_empty: Fill in the form and the plan will appear here.
adapt_disclaimer: Plan generated automatically from the innovation's Library entry. Costs are estimates. Please consult the plan with the ROPS team.
admin_reply_sent: Reply sent. The author has been notified.
admin_moderation_help: These reports may contain personal data. Approving publishes the anonymised version and runs matching.
admin_reindex_note: After saving, the innovation is re-indexed in search automatically.
admin_form_schema_help: List of fields: key, label_pl, type (text, textarea, number, select), optional help_pl, max_length, options.
trends_lead: Aggregated report data, visible to the ROPS team only. Refreshed every 10 minutes.
trends_heat_help: Number of reports in each cell; the darker the background, the more.
chart_aria: Bar chart: {title}. The same data is available as a table.
